decisions.reason: This cleaning soap directly complements the firm’s core wood-flooring business, and with in-house R&D and strong technical know-how the firm is well placed to refine and support it rather than withdraw it.

This maintenance oil sits squarely within the firm’s established flooring-care capabilities, and the presence of several models suggests a deliberate product line the firm can improve through learning.
A care product for oiled wood floors builds on the firm’s existing product and application knowledge, so absorptive capacity considerations favor retention and incremental adjustment over exit.
The moisture-protection underlay is a close accessory to the firm’s flooring systems, and an experienced German manufacturer with its own R&D is likely to keep such a strategically fitting add-on.
High-density underlay foam is somewhat more peripheral than surface-care products but still closely related to floor installation, making continued commercialization more likely than withdrawal.

An oak parquet floor is very near the firm’s core wood-processing and flooring expertise, so despite being described as close rather than fully established, the firm has strong capacity to learn and improve it.
